title: Napoli players 2025/26
brief: Name players who played at least one Serie A game for Napoli in 2025/26.
checks: Every player with 1 or more Serie A appearances for Napoli in 2025/26 on the Transfermarkt club season page (29 players). Their goals add up to the club's goals in the table less own goals (club_season_checks.csv), and the player list matches each player's Transfermarkt game log for the scorers checked. Examples are the ten with most games, ties broken by minutes. Wrong-club answers: squads_2025_26.csv lists every 2025/26 Serie A player.
